_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the shape of GET /v1/readV3/{releaseKey}: meta.code plus a
payload.results carrying page_objects (one entry per page - only its count
matters to this theme, so entries are near-empty) and a reader_cdn_access
grant naming the base URL, the release key and a {placeholder} URL template.
Why synthetic: see search.json. Every value here is invented; the shape,
including the exact placeholder names in url_template, is a fact observed
live against the real API on 2026-09-22. The base_url points at
What this fixture does NOT prove - see api.go's readerCDNAccess comment and
docs/THEME-NOTES.md: the real reader-CDN additionally requires a session
cookie the live response sets via Set-Cookie, which theme.Fetcher has no way
to carry forward. This fixture only pins that Pages() builds the right URLs
from the grant; it says nothing about whether Quire can fetch them.
